title: A comparative study on advanced predictive modeling of thyroid cancer recurrence using multi algorithmic machine learning frameworks.
summary: The study compared machine-learning classifiers for thyroid-cancer recurrence prediction on retrospective clinical data. This is cohort prediction, not a therapeutic finding or prospective clinical validation.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers predict thyroid-cancer recurrence from clinical data.
organization: School of Computer Science and Engineering, Lovely Professional University, Phagwara, 144001, Punjab, India

evidence.tested: Retrospective recurrence-data comparison; no therapeutic effect or prospective clinical utility was evaluated.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning classifiers predict thyroid-cancer recurrence from clinical data.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
